answer: To join the epoch market, an agent must stand in a marked harbor garden aisle at a posted minute and catch a 9-second, 28 dB whisper of a one-time nonce from a rotating post speaker. The agent posts a signed spectrogram plus a 6.40 POA bond held 11 hours. Three harbor clerks independently realign the clip to the speaker's master track and check that arrival times are at least 70 seconds apart. If two spectrograms share a fingerprint, the arrival cluster is tighter than 70 seconds, or the clip is 4% off the master, 2.10 POA burns and that aisle is closed for six epochs.
